projects.title: BloodDonation
projects.subtitle: Blood Donation & Logistics Management System
projects.description: Backend API system for end-to-end blood donation lifecycle management — from donor registration and donation scheduling to blood inventory, transport logistics, and real-time hospital blood requests. Built with NestJS and deployed via Docker/Railway.
myContributions: Designed and implemented a RESTful API for end-to-end blood donation lifecycle management, covering donor registration, donation scheduling, blood inventory tracking, and hospital blood requests.
Built a Central Blood Storage module managing hospital and mobile blood banks, including CRUD operations, blood expiry tracking, and real-time status updates (available, in-use, expired).
Developed a Blood Export & Logistics module to handle transport orders from central storage to mobile/hospital units, with shipment status tracking (In Transit, Delivered, Expired).
Implemented real-time push notifications via WebSocket Gateway to alert staff on blood expiry and new availability; integrated EmailJS for automated email verification and notifications.
Integrated an AI Chatbot to assist donors and staff with blood donation FAQs, medical eligibility, and process guidance.
Built a Geolocation-powered Search module to find nearest blood storage by GPS coordinates, filter by blood type, and query by province/city.
Implemented JWT-based authentication with Refresh Token rotation, password hashing, email verification, and role-based access control (Admin, Donor, Receiver, Doctor).
Deployed using Docker with CI/CD pipeline configuration and cloud hosting on Railway.
Developed donor registration and onboarding pages on the web frontend, handling form validation and API integration.
Built location-based search UI on both web and mobile, allowing users to find nearby blood storage facilities by GPS coordinates and filter by blood type.

projects.title: BookingCare
projects.subtitle: Online Medical Appointment Booking API
projects.description: Backend API system for an online medical appointment booking platform. Built with Clean Architecture, CQRS, and Event-Driven design on ASP.NET Core 10. Supports doctor schedule management, slot-based booking with conflict detection, and booking lifecycle management from creation to completion.
myContributions: Designed and implemented Clean Architecture with strict dependency rules across Domain, Application, Infrastructure, and API layers.
Built Auth module with JWT access token (15-min) + Refresh Token rotation, BCrypt password hashing, email verification via Redis, and account lockout after 5 failed login attempts.
Applied CQRS with MediatR — commands and queries fully separated, with validation pipeline via FluentValidation and structured logging via Serilog.
Implemented Rich Domain Model with Result pattern for business rule violations instead of throwing exceptions, and Domain Events dispatched post-SaveChanges.
Built Doctor & Schedule module with slot-based scheduling (1-hour slots, 7:00–17:00), conflict detection via unique constraint, and available slot caching with Redis.
Designed Booking lifecycle with strict status transitions: Pending → Confirmed → Completed/Cancelled/Rescheduled, with pessimistic locking to prevent double booking.
Implemented event-driven side effects: booking confirmation emails, cancellation notifications, and 24-hour reminder jobs via domain events.
Containerized with Docker Compose (PostgreSQL + Redis) and configured Swagger with JWT Bearer support for full API documentation.
